topic_kernel.artifact: a probe and intervention on learned features

competency.practice_task: Produce a glossary with a positive and a negative case grounded in a probe and intervention on learned features.
competency.setting_constraint: Have a separate evaluator hold unseen items and answer keys.
required_evidence: a glossary with a positive and a negative case
Include item-set hash, evaluator identity and aggregate verdict only.
Report linear probe transfer and feature robustness with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: equating probe score with causal use.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of representation learning.
Practice: the definitions separate valid from invalid cases.
Measurement: report linear probe transfer and feature robustness against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for equating probe score with causal use; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
